flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:44 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_692577.description:
The Justice Department is appealing the dismissal of its antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard, seeking to revive a case involving nearly $1 billion.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692576.description:
Finland announces it will end its funding for UNRWA when its current agreement expires. Israel’s Foreign Ministry welcomes the move: UNRWA is a hotbed of terrorism.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692575.description:
Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei calls for national unity and stronger public morale as US economic pressure on Tehran intensifies.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692578.description: Two Hamas terrorists advancing attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire, are eliminated in Gaza.

flash_692585.description: Rare late-August weather system brings strong winds and haze, with heavy rain and localized flooding possible in northern Israel.

flash_692584.description: Intelligence on a concrete threat prompted the urgent evacuation of the Prime Minister’s son from Florida to Israel under heavy security.

flash_692582.description: In an emotional interview, Omer Shem Tov, speaks of the guilt he still feels, his friendship with Uri Danino, the moment he surrendered himself to G-d deep inside the tunnel, and the dream he has embraced since returning home: to win an Oscar.

flash_692580.description: Clashes erupt in Qusra, Jalud, after Israelis begin to hit back following rock attack by local Arabs.

flash_692592.description: Iris Haim, whose son was accidentally killed in Gaza, says anger and revenge over the killing of an Israeli by IDF soldiers will only lead to more deaths.

flash_692591.description: New report says Palestinian Authority officials pushed Arab parties to unite against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud hits back.

flash_692589.description: Anti-Israel activist targeted one of three children near the Barkai neighborhood; residents detained the suspect until police arrived, Har Hevron Council says.

flash_692587.description: What started with a polite request to lower the volume allegedly ended with a violent assault, a police investigation, and a shaken guesthouse owner questioning whether he should have called police sooner.

flash_692583.description: Itamar Ben Gvir accuses Netanyahu and Smotrich of using a staged unity push to pressure Moshe Feiglin into lowering his demands for an electoral bloc.

flash_692581.description: At least 13 buses from northern Israel stopped as protesters block entrance to Jerusalem over public transportation operating on the Sabbath.

flash_692579.description: Hamas commander planning attacks against troops and Israeli civilians, working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire, is eliminated while hiding in hospital.

flash_692593.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply criticizes the Attorney General over the controversy surrounding a memorial event for his father: “She is going after Maran, and this will not go unanswered."

flash_692588.description: Hundreds of trucks carrying food, medical supplies and water infrastructure equipment entered Gaza through Israel, while 150 residents departed for third countries, official data reveals.

flash_692586.description: More than NIS 200,000 in debt, a surprise 50th birthday party and an apartment left untouched: New details reveal what preceded Mali and Liel Yahalomi’s mysterious departure.

flash_692607.description: The more I understood the riotous Jewish tribe, the more I realized that a nation that can barely run the so-called "West Bank" (or, for that matter, a heated Knesset session) is unlikely to deviously pull the strings behind everything happening in the world. But never mind. Opinion.

flash_692606.description: An 8-year-old boy fell from a height and was evacuated in serious condition with a head injury. According to initial suspicions, the boy was locked in his room on the fourth floor and tried to get out through the balcony.

flash_692605.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply attacked Rabbi Dov Lior as part of his remarks opposing visits to the Temple Mount: “He does not come up to the ankles of any of the rabbis I mentioned."

flash_692603.description: The IDF is presenting its range of dedicated tracks - from Paratroopers and Hasmonean Brigade combat soldiers to intelligence researchers and personnel in technology and logistics.

flash_692601.description: The National Security Minister visited a prison where female Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorists are incarcerated and heard complaints about worsening conditions

flash_692599.description: The weather today will be partly cloudy, with localized rain expected until noon, mainly in the north of the country. Temperatures will drop further and will be lower than normal for the season, mainly in the mountains and inland.

flash_692597.description: Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed apologizes for controversial remarks as he works to win over skeptical Jewish Democrats ahead of November.

flash_692595.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian admits US sanctions are hurting Iran's economy, days after insisting the measures would achieve nothing.

flash_692590.description: By portraying Israel and the West as preternaturally blameworthy, leftists advance the cause of Islamism. Opinion.

flash_692622.description: A new agricultural outpost, Beitrun, was established in the Jordan Valley on Sunday, with the first structures placed on the site under the jurisdiction of the Jordan Valley Regional Council.

flash_692621.description: JPPI Voice of the Jewish People Index finds 64% view Iran campaign as a failure, while 55% say US military action did not go far enough.

flash_692620.description: JPPI Voice of the Jewish People Index finds 54% prefer the current opposition, while 14% prefer the current coalition; 78% follow election news closely.

flash_692618.description: 29-year-old Rahat resident and medical graduate allegedly fled police on Route 77, ramming a patrol car before being stopped. An M16 rifle matching parts found in his vehicle was later recovered.

flash_692616.description: Police surveillance operators identified an incident of animal abuse near the Lions’ Gate. A 15-year-old minor was arrested.

flash_692614.description: Police forces, Search and Rescue Unit volunteers, and hundreds of residents searched throughout the night for two brothers, ages 3 and 7, from Tekoa.

flash_692612.description: The word “terrorism" requires sensitivity. Condemning Israel apparently does not... Opinion.

flash_692610.description: Doctors save the life of an elderly woman who suffered severe respiratory distress after a 15-centimeter hair tie became lodged in her esophagus, blocking more than 80% of her airway.

flash_692608.description: A Tel Aviv man said Yehuda Poliker was the only person who could convince him not to jump. Police woke the singer in the middle of the night and his intervention succeeded.

flash_692604.description: As the third anniversary of the October 7 massacre approaches, the Israeli defense establishment assesses that Hamas is continuing to rebuild its military strength.

flash_692602.description: The genius-and danger-of this model is its ability to fragment an operation among people who understand only a fraction of it. Tehran’s reported covert networks use digital recruitment, criminal intermediaries, and deniable local operatives. Opinion.

flash_692600.description:
The Nepal Disaster Management Authority has updated that the death toll in the country's floods has risen to 734 people.

It was also reported that about 2,500 people are listed as missing.

flash_692598.description:
CIA Director John Ratcliffe has proposed holding a three-way meeting between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, in an attempt to bring an end to the war in Ukraine, two sources familiar with the details told the Axios news website.

According to the report, the proposal was raised during Ratcliffe's secret visit to Moscow a few days ago.

flash_692596.description: US Embassy in Beirut says Hezbollah must disarm, accusing the Iran-backed group of refusing talks because it is taking orders from Tehran.

flash_692594.description: Yair Netanyahu sharply criticizes National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir, claiming: “The police have definitively become Kaplan’s enforcement arm."

flash_692639.description: Three Hesder soldiers were sentenced to 10 days in military prison after refusing to board a Namer with a female medic, sparking fierce backlash from rabbis and politicians.

flash_692638.description: Arab affairs pundit Zvi Yehezkeli spots a Turkish flag on a Palestinian vehicle near Jerusalem and warns of growing admiration for Erdogan.

flash_692637.description: The new academic year begins soon. This is the time to insist that University professors teach our students the same Jewish and Zionist values held by the Israeli taxpayers and Jewish donors who pay their salaries. Opinion.

flash_692635.description: Malfunction causes Tel Aviv-bound BlueBird flight to return to Athens, passengers left on board

flash_692633.description: Former US ambassador to Israel David Friedman tweeted in response to the reports of clashes between Israelis and Palestinians in the town of Qusra over Shabbat.

flash_692631.description: In this video, Israeli spokesman Ezra Tubi exposes how the story of Qusra fits into a familiar pattern of strategic propaganda.

flash_692629.description: Yisrael Beytenu will present its slate for the Knesset elections next week during an event at Expo Tel Aviv.

flash_692627.description: Slovenian leaders trade barbs over Israel and EU policy, as PM Janez Janša rejects pressure from Brussels and wins praise from Netanyahu.

flash_692625.description: Weekly Slichot services are taking hold at the Temple Mount’s eastern wall as organizers seek to renew Jewish prayer at the ancient Jerusalem site.

flash_692623.description: Prominent Hasidic rabbis are reportedly set to meet President Trump at the White House, where the Satmar Rebbe plans to raise Israel’s yeshiva draft issue.

flash_692619.description: A passenger ferry capsized off the coast of Kyrenia shortly after departing for Turkey. Rescue forces and the coast guard are working to save approximately 270 people.

flash_692617.description: Border Police officers discover NIS 1.4 million concealed inside a double wall of a vehicle entering Jerusalem, suspect the cash due to be used as terror money.

flash_692615.description: Gantz says the Biden administration sent four senior officers to dissuade Israel from taking military action in Gaza.

flash_692611.description: Hundreds of haredi recruits arrived at Tel Hashomer induction center, many joining combat tracks, with one Hasmonean Brigade recruit saying: 'We all need to take responsibility, haredi or not.'

flash_692652.description: Iran's IRGC threatens retaliation after a US strike on Larak Island kills two people and targets Iranian launchers preparing to deploy sea mines.

flash_692651.description: Advisory committee recommends protection for Gadi Eisenkot until election day after new findings, reversing a decision that sparked controversy.

flash_692650.description: IDU handlers and specialized search dogs trained alongside Haruv soldiers in a challenging northern Israel exercise designed to prepare for complex scenarios in hostile terrain.

flash_692649.description: It is Elul. And the voice of prayer merges with the early morning sound of a shofar, echoes in the sound of the bird singing on my porch rail this morning.

flash_692648.description: A leading Religious Zionist rabbinic group condemns public remarks against Rabbi Dov Lior after Rabbi Yitzchak Yosef targeted him for scathing public critique.

flash_692647.description: One who observes carefully can see that God’s Kingship is being revealed more and more in our time.

flash_692646.description: Lebanese reports of Israeli strikes in Kfar Roummane and Qantara in southern Lebanon

flash_692645.description:
Axios cited a US official who said that earlier in the day, US forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island.

According to the official, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces were observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_692644.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed in an interview with Channel 14 that he met with Ofer Winter. Netanyahu said that he "offered him, 'Come to us, and you'll be welcomed.' He chose to a seperate path and we're in trouble.'

flash_692643.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was interviewed on Channel 14 on Sunday evening and said, “The very existence of the State of Israel is at stake in this election."

flash_692642.description: Advisory committee recommends Shin Bet protection for Gadi Eisenkot

flash_692641.description: Report says Ofer Winter rejected Netanyahu’s offer of reserved Likud slots before launching his own party; despite backing Netanyahu, Likud remains wary.

flash_692640.description: Kan News poll gives Ofir Winter’s new party four seats, while Netanyahu edges Bennett for premiership and neither political bloc reaches 61.

flash_692636.description: University professors must teach our students the same Jewish and Zionist values held by the Israeli taxpayers and Jewish donors who pay their salaries. Opinion.

flash_692634.description:
UKMTO is reporting that a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting inbound in the Strait of Hormuz, 12 NM north of Khasab, Oman.

No casualties or environmental impact are reported at this time.

Authorities are investigating.

flash_692632.description: Who are the Druze? They are Arab in language, culture, and DNA, but It is their religion that is unique. And what is the covenant of blood? Op-ed.

flash_692630.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich orders an excise tax cut to offset a planned 16-agura fuel price hike, with the reduction expected within days.

flash_692628.description: Forecasters expected an unusual late-August storm, but the system shifted north and spared central Israel. Meteo-Tech’s chief forecaster explains what happened.

flash_692626.description: Senior US military leaders reportedly warn that prolonged operations against Iran are straining forces and could weaken readiness against threats elsewhere.

flash_692624.description: United Airlines announces return of year-round nonstop service between Tel Aviv and San Francisco, as part of expansion of its Israel-US flight schedule.

flash_692659.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) claimed responsibility for the missile launches towards Jordan.

flash_692658.description:
A man in his 50s was seriously injured in a violent incident in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) medics treated him at the scene before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_692656.description: Watch: Interceptions in Jordan after Iran missile launch

flash_692655.description: Reports of explosions in Jordan following launch from Iran

flash_692654.description:
Iranian media outlets are reporting that missiles were launched at US military vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

The reported attack comes after the US strike on targets in Iran and threats by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps to retaliate.

flash_692653.description:
The IDF announced that 16 soldiers were sentenced after refusing to board a Namer armored personnel carrier in which a female paramedic was present.

“The incident was investigated, and command measures were taken against those involved. Five of the soldiers who led the incident were sentenced to 10 days of confinement, while 11 additional soldiers were sentenced to five days of confinement. Two of the five soldiers sentenced to 10 days of confinement will undergo an evaluation committee before returning to combat," the military said.

flash_692672.description: Several Canadian websites mistakenly display “Lake America" after Google renames Lake Ontario in the US in accordance with Trump executive order.

flash_692671.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed it shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone over the Strait of Hormuz.

The claim has not yet been confirmed by the United States.

flash_692670.description: Two weeks after the Likud primary and amid fraud allegations, the party releases final results, placing Eti Atiya 25th and Gila Gamliel 35th.

flash_692668.description: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei calls the US and Israel “sworn enemies" of Muslim unity and urges greater solidarity across the Muslim world.

flash_692666.description: Speaking on Fox News, President Donald Trump says Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon, touting the US blockade and military campaign while warning of catastrophic regional consequences.

flash_692664.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the Trump administration plans new bank sanctions as Washington intensifies efforts to isolate Iran economically.

flash_692662.description: Rabbi Sir Ephraim Mirvis warns planned UK sanctions over Israeli construction in E1 could harm British Jews, trade ties and prospects for Middle East peace.

flash_692660.description: Amcha Yisrael chairman Ofer Winter responds to the Prime Minister’s claim that his party poses a “danger" to the right: “We are part of the right-wing camp, but we work for no one."

flash_692657.description: US source to Fox News: Nearly all incoming missiles have been intercepted

flash_692687.description:
Nepal's Foreign Ministry has updated the number of foreign nationals still missing following the floods which struck the country, saying that 590 people remain unaccounted for.

The missing individuals are citizens of 39 different countries. So far, 323 foreign nationals have been rescued.

flash_692686.description: Inspectors uncover 100 bottles hidden inside drinks at Kerem Shalom; truck seized and Israeli company’s Gaza aid permit suspended.

flash_692685.description: Police open kidnapping investigation after Petah Tikva boy vanishes; Jerusalem suspect found is arrested and jailed.

flash_692683.description: Rabbi Ovadia Yosef’s daughters, Rivka Chikotai and Adina Bar-Shalom, sharply criticize Shas, accusing the party and Aryeh Deri of abandoning their father’s legacy.

flash_692681.description: Wanted terrorist suspected of plotting attacks against Israelis is caught off guard at his home in a covert overnight operation.

flash_692679.description: Haredi recruits describe their decision to enlist, concerns about the changes ahead, and their determination to maintain their haredi identity and way of life while serving in the IDF.

flash_692677.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich demands answers from the IDF after hesder soldiers were sent to military prison for refusing to enter a Namer with a female paramedic.

flash_692675.description: Court awards NIS 180,000 to three Jews attacked by an Arab mob near the Lions’ Gate during Operation Guardian of the Walls.

flash_692673.description: Seven arrested and six detained as police probe bribery, rigged tenders and alleged fictitious employees used to siphon public funds.

flash_692669.description: Retired Port Authority officers urge NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani to skip the 25th anniversary 9/11 ceremony, warning his presence could cause pain.

flash_692667.description: The Prime Minister says he would promote the establishment of agricultural farms, stressing the national importance of strengthening Jewish presence in the Negev and Galilee.

flash_692665.description: A confidential memorandum of understanding between the two countries outlines closer defense coordination through 2034, including research, development and military procurement.

flash_692663.description:
The Jordanian military announced that it had intercepted eight missiles that entered the country's airspace.

The statement came after Iran claimed responsibility for an attack on two US military bases in Jordan.

flash_692661.description: Watch: IRGC footage of launches towards Jordan

flash_692715.description: Israeli forces demolish illegal construction near the security fence and an ancient archaeological site in two-day enforcement operation in Area C.

flash_692713.description: Police arrest a suspect over sedatives allegedly injected into Prinok baby food after three Jerusalem-area infants were hospitalized with severe symptoms.

flash_692711.description: After making Aliyah from France, cousins Gad and Elior enlist in the IDF’s Hasmonean Brigade, driven by faith, duty and a desire to defend Israel.

flash_692709.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated: "The security agreement signed today with Greece, one of the largest in the country's history, is a direct continuation of the Eastern Mediterranean alliance we forged a decade ago with Greece and Cyprus. It serves as further proof of the tremendous capabilities of Israel's defense and technological industries. This move expresses Israel's strength, the confidence in our defense exports, and the strengthening of regional alliances."

flash_692707.description: A nuclear war - any nuclear war - would resemble an incurable disease. Of necessity, all meaningful “therapies" must lie in prevention. Opinion.

flash_692705.description: Police have decided to increase security around Supreme Court Justice and Central Elections Committee Chairman Noam Sohlberg following a situation assessment and intelligence that was received.

flash_692703.description: With draft dodgers facing obstacles to leaving Israel, Breslov organizers prepare Meron for thousands who may be unable to spend Rosh Hashanah in Uman.

flash_692701.description: Unusual weather conditions caused severe turbidity in the seawater, leading to the shutdown of desalination plants south of Hadera.

flash_692699.description: Following Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef’s criticism of Rabbi Dov Lior, a historic letter resurfaces revealing Rabbi Tzvi Yehuda Kook’s glowing praise for him.

flash_692698.description:
US President Donald Trump told Fox News on Monday that the US will respond to the Iranian attack on US forces overnight in Jordan. "We're going to hit them hard; there will be a response."

The President indicated that all except for one missile were intercepted.

flash_692697.description: US President calls Iran a 'failed state' that has killed over 100,00 of its own people.

flash_692696.description: Three Force 100 soldiers seek 18 million shekels from prosecutors, law enforcement officials and media figures, alleging false arrest, leaks and defamation.

flash_692695.description: As catastrophe strikes Nepal, Israelis have once again travelled thousands of miles to help strangers. Real Tikkun Olam demands that we perfect the world God rules - and what better way than to try repair a broken world, even when parts of that world despise us.

flash_692694.description: Two veteran pharmacists were arrested on suspicion of taking tens of thousands of medications intended for soldiers and selling them on the black market for tens of thousands of shekels.

flash_692693.description: Leket Israel Founder and Chairman Joseph Gitler discusses rescuing surplus food, supporting Israeli farmers and expanding food assistance ahead of Rosh Hashanah, with a goal of distributing more than 700,000 meals to people in need.

flash_692692.description: Shiran, mother of 10-year-old Yaheli, reveals how a 20-year-old allegedly manipulated her son, took him on a bus to Bnei Brak and used him to collect donations.

flash_692691.description: After years in which Israel’s haredi political representatives made too many Jews resent us, Moti Leitner and his new party may be achieving what once seemed impossible. Opinion.

flash_692690.description: Katrina (Katya) Sakovich disappeared after a flash flood struck the area of the Rasuwagadhi-Gyirong border crossing. Her sister is due to travel to Nepal and join the search efforts. Another Israeli, a man in his 60s, is still missing.

flash_692689.description:
The Foreign Ministry has confirmed that Israeli citizen Katrina Sakovich has been missing since the flood disaster in Nepal.

In addition, searches are continuing for another Israeli citizen, a man in his 60s.

flash_692688.description: Lapid’s longtime political partner gives up his spot for the party’s 'next generation' but says he isn’t leaving Yesh Atid.
